instruction: Run `node scripts/build.mjs` and make it succeed so that dist/catalog.json is produced. The build script is correct: fix the input data, not the script, and keep every product. Prices are integer cents.
done_when: all five products are still in data/products.json with valid integer priceCents
dist/catalog.json exists with the expected count, totalCents and skus
re-running the build from a clean copy succeeds and produces the same catalog
